title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox will sustain current performance and make the 2026 playoffs despite strong record.
Red Sox hold second A.L. wild-card spot with record of 64-52 after historic winning streaks.
FanGraphs gives Red Sox a 96% chance of making playoffs, with 83.4% for wild-card spot.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was scratched from Saturday's Red Sox lineup due to leg swelling after being hit during Friday's game.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday’s game against the Athletics, pending a morning evaluation.
Abreu has been a key player with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, following an eventful performance this week.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday.
Jake Bennett allowed four runs over 5.1 innings in his 13th start, as Boston's pitching struggled.
The Red Sox are 64-52 and hold the second wild-card spot, 1.5 games behind the New York Yankees.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium to replace turf surface before Patriots' preseason game due to NFL rules.
Turf installed post-World Cup didn't meet NFL lab testing requirements for non-E-layer fields.
New surface will revert to pre-World Cup turf used by Patriots and Revolution in 2025.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, despite Jack Harrison's debut.
Houston's Guilherme and Agustin Resch scored, capitalizing on New England's defensive errors.
Designated Player Jack Harrison played from 55th minute but couldn't impact New England's offense.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony is training with a pitching machine to recover from a wrist injury, aiming for a late season return.
Adley Rutschman made a rehab appearance with the Worcester Red Sox, moving closer to debuting with Boston's MLB team.
Despite injuries, the Red Sox are on a 9-game winning streak, with Anthony and Rutschman expected to strengthen the lineup.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless' (1995) and 'Eighth Grade' (2018) are highlighted streaming picks on Netflix this August.
New releases include 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' (2026) on Paramount+ and 'You, Me & Tuscany' (2026) on Peacock.
Boston.com staff recommends 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' Season 4 on Paramount+ and 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 on Apple TV.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
BFRO has recorded 126 verified Bigfoot sightings in New England since 1994, with expeditions frequently held by enthusiasts.
Skeptics cite the lack of scientific evidence for Bigfoot, while some suggest it fulfills a need for belief in the extraordinary.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Meredith Goldstein reflects on the impact of her friend Margo Howard, who passed away at 86.
Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, was noted for her practical and empathetic advice columns.
Goldstein recalls Howard's valuable life advice, including balancing grief and finding joy after loss.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters, aiding Boston Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Oakland Athletics.
The Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games with 15 hits and multiple high-scoring innings.
Raymond Burgos debuted for Boston, pitching three scoreless innings after being recalled from Triple-A Worcester.
